cohort: Pregnant women who delivered at a tertiary care center in southern India between March 2014 and March 2018.
finding: The maternal mortality ratio was 205/100,000 live births, with the leading causes of death being sepsis (48.6%) and postpartum hemorrhage (20%).
mod_finding: 50.5% of deliveries were by Cesarean section and 49.5% were vaginal deliveries.
